question: On type I myotonic dystrophy (Steinert's disease), point out the INCORRECT statement:

options.opa: Muscle weakness in extremities is predominantly distal.
options.opb: It is an autosomal recessive disease with almost complete penetrance.
options.opc: In this disease, posterior subcapsular cataracts are characteristic.
options.opd: The frequent occurrence of cardiac conduction blocks should be monitored.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Muscle weakness in extremities is predominantly distal -> Correct CHAIN: It is an autosomal recessive disease with almost complete penetrance -> Incorrect -> 80% CHAIN: In this disease, posterior subcapsular cataracts are characteristic -> Correct CHAIN: The frequent occurrence of cardiac conduction blocks should be monitored -> Correct -> 80%
analysis: Myotonic dystrophy type I, also known as Steinert's disease, is an autosomal dominant disorder, not autosomal recessive. It has almost complete penetrance, and muscle weakness in extremities is predominantly distal. Posterior subcapsular cataracts and cardiac conduction blocks are indeed characteristic features of the disease.
